about: cs #251·AL check (b): originals the Opus judge refused in their new cym_for_kor basket (whole-course dry plan on the 24 Nov 17:57Z snapshot); ZUT refusals and baskets left under the floor

refused_originals.target: os dw i ddim yn siŵr
refused_originals.known: 내가 확실하지 않으면
refused_originals.en: if I’m not sure
refused_originals.why: Here os is the conditional 'if' (~면), but this LEGO teaches os as 'whether' (~지), so it uses the LEGO in the wrong sense

refused_originals.target: yn nes ymlaen
refused_originals.known: 나중에

refused_originals.why: the Korean prompt '나중에' is identical to the LEGO's own prompt but asks for a different Welsh form (yn nes ymlaen vs nes ymlaen), which breaks ZUT

refused_originals.target: dw i isio siarad Cymraeg ond fedra i ddim cofio gair
refused_originals.known: 나는 웨일스어를 이야기하고 싶어, 하지만 나는 단어 하나도 기억할 수 없어
refused_originals.en: I want to speak Welsh but I can’t remember a word
refused_originals.why: The Welsh does not contain the LEGO 'dw i ddim isio'. It has the affirmative 'dw i isio' plus 'fedra i ddim', so it cannot practise this LEGO.

refused_originals.target: dw i isio esbonio be’ dw i’n ei olygu ond fedra i ddim

refused_originals.why: The Welsh does not contain the LEGO 'dw i ddim isio'. It has only the affirmative 'dw i isio' and 'fedra i ddim'.

refused_originals.target: dw i ddim yn siŵr os dw i isio ateb

refused_originals.why: The LEGO 'dw i ddim isio' is not present. 'dw i ddim' belongs to 'dw i ddim yn siŵr', and 'isio' comes later in 'os dw i isio'. Different structure and sense.

refused_originals.target: pam wyt ti isio
